The  members of the commission hold office for such   period

The main functions Or duties of the Finance Commission are
To recommend to the President the basis for distribution of the net
proceeds of taxes between the centre and states_
To recommend the principles which should govern the grants in-aid
to be given to states out of the consolidated Fund of India.
To tender advice to the President on any other matter referred to the
Commission in the interest of sound finance
To suggest amounts to be paid to the states of Assam, Bihar; Odisha
